observation.visible_scene: An open-ocean scene with a breaking wave. A surfer in a dark wetsuit rides a short white surfboard along the wave's shoulder, kicking up spray. In the background two other surfers lie prone on their boards, mostly stationary relative to the water. White foam of the breaking section occupies the left of the frame, with the unbroken face to the right.
visible_changes: At the start the surfer is crouched low on the board with a fan-shaped spray plume rising behind him; this spray plume persists for the first several frames while the surfer holds a riding stance with one arm extended for balance.
The surfer's body shifts from a deep crouch to a more upright stance and back as he travels along the wave face; the board stays roughly horizontal on the water during this early phase.
Around the middle of the clip the board's nose lifts and the board rotates toward a vertical orientation (tail near the water, nose pointing up), and the surfer tucks his body low over the rail.
As the board goes vertical a rounded cloud of spray forms behind/around the surfer, briefly enveloping the board and obscuring it (occlusion, not disappearance).

After the spray cloud subsides the board returns to a horizontal planing position and the surfer resumes a crouched riding stance with a fan-shaped spray behind him, continuing toward the right side of the frame.

The background prone surfer on the right drifts leftward across the frame over the whole clip, and the breaking whitewater on the left advances/changes shape, indicating the wave is rolling and the view is tracking the rider.
The main surfer's position relative to the background surfer moves rightward over time, consistent with riding down the line of the wave.
outside_clip_unknowns: How the ride was initiated (paddle, drop-in) is not shown; the clip begins mid-ride.
Whether the vertical-board maneuver was a deliberate turn (cutback/off-the-top) or a loss of balance, and whether the surfer stayed up after the clip ends, is not visible.
The full shape and continuation of the wave beyond the cropped frame are unknown.
uncertain_details: It is uncertain how much of the apparent leftward drift of the background is camera pan versus surfer translation; the surfer's motion relative to the wave face is clearer than absolute motion.
The exact board angle during the maneuver is hard to read because spray occludes it; the board appears vertical but precise orientation is uncertain.
The identity/number of background surfers is partly ambiguous due to distance and foam (a head/shoulder on the far left may be another person).
